semantic_table.description: The "Exploration" stage, describing early prospecting and surveying to locate valuable mineral deposits.
The "Mine Design" stage, outlining environmental, community, and extraction planning before mining begins.
The "Mine Construction" stage, describing the building of mine infrastructure such as roads, power, and landing strips.
The "Production" stage, explaining ongoing mineral extraction and exploration during the mine’s operating life.
The "End Game" stage, describing ramp-down, removal of equipment, and mine-site reclamation planning.
The "Reclamation" stage, describing restoring the land after mining and mitigating long-term environmental impacts.
